name: Marketing data in five places
summary: Gathers the firm's marketing numbers, which sit in five places (ads, website, search, leads and the practice system), into one report. Only the ad account is mapped so far: each day it reads Meta campaign spend, leads and cost per lead, and writes a report for the owner to read. Crons read and write the workflow's own store only; nothing is changed in the ad account and nothing is sent.

covered_by.pull-ad-data: draft (Meta campaign insights for the window, read only)
covered_by.pull-search-data: not yet (no platform mapped for this job)
covered_by.define-metrics: cron (spend, leads and cost per lead, fixed in the review cron)
covered_by.clean-combine: not yet (only one source is read)
covered_by.build-dashboard: not yet (the report is a store record, not a dashboard)
covered_by.schedule-refresh: cron (pull at 21:00 UTC, review at 22:00 UTC)
covered_by.review-report: cron (review writes the report; the owner reads it)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (the snapshot and report kept in the workflow store)

crons.name: pull
crons.summary: Campaign spend, impressions, clicks and leads for the window, kept for review (21:00 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: review
crons.summary: Writes the campaign report from the last pull (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Only reads reach the platform. The report and snapshot are written to the workflow store, which reaches nobody outside the firm. No live operation is mapped for this job: changing an ad, a budget or a pixel would need its own build and an approval step.

meta-ads.covers: campaign-level insights for one ad account: spend, impressions, clicks, lead actions, date range

gaps: Only one of the five places is mapped. The docs name Meta Ads alone, so website analytics, search visibility, lead sources and the practice system are not wired.

The Meta platform pages describe no professional services steps: matter matching, dashboards, a refresh schedule and a leadership review are not covered by the platform. The refresh here is the cron schedule, not a Meta feature.
The meta-ads platform is spec status and tested offline only (platform.json). The insights field names are confirmed against the vendor spec (AdsInsights), but no live ad account has been read.
The report lives in the workflow store only. No platform receives it yet, so the owner reads it from the CRM shell.
No live operations: this job changes nothing in an ad account, so there is no approval step. A pause or budget change would need its own build.
The judgment steps stay with the owner: which campaigns to keep, scale or stop, and what a lead is worth to the firm.
